emails.subject: Lease LOI - 2225 Page Mill Road
emails.body:
Hi Omar,

We've agreed on a non-binding LOI with Riverstone Properties LLC for about 42,000 RSF at 2225 Page Mill Road: 10-year term, $68/RSF with 3% annual bumps, and a TI allowance of $95/RSF. Can you start reviewing the landlord's form lease?

Thanks,
Uma Brennan
Director of Real Estate
Redwood Biosciences

emails.subject: Response to notice of breach
emails.body:
Counsel,

We disagree that the outages constitute a material breach. Most of the downtime was caused by your client's own configuration changes. Our client is nevertheless willing to discuss service credits without prejudice.

Thanks,
Whitney Thompson
Partner
Zhang & Underwood LLP

emails.subject: TI allowance and rent commencement
emails.body:

Best regards,
Femi

Ironbridge Commercial Realty
